custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the right-hand iPod. AI generators often struggle with symmetrical mechanical interfaces when viewed at an angle. Check if the click wheel maintains perfect circularity and if the center button is distinct. Also, verify if the 'off' state of the screen is rendered realistically (deep black) or if it shows faint generative noise.
